title: EHAL Setpoint-API (schema_version 2)
description: Limit/mode setpoints. ESS limits in W (non-negative magnitudes); EVCS currents in A. At least one setpoint field required. Field names: docs/ui/ehal-com.md §C.

set_ess_charge_power_limit.description: Max ESS charge power in W (magnitude).

set_ess_discharge_power_limit.description: Max ESS discharge power in W (magnitude).

set_ess_mode.description: ESS mode / control command (e.g. Huawei control_cmd).

set_evcs_max_current.description: EV charge current setpoint / max current in A.

set_evcs_mode.description: EV charge mode: pv (PV-follow) or now (immediate).
